spots.name: Saratov Bridge
spots.summary: Saratov Bridge, crossing the Volga River in Saratov, Russia was the longest bridge in the Soviet Union upon its inauguration in 1965. Its length is 2,803.7 meters (9,198 ft). It connects Saratov on the right (west) bank of the Volga, with the city of Engels on the left (east) bank.

spots.name: Saratov State University
spots.summary: Saratov Chernyshevsky State University is a higher education and research institution in Russia. In 2023 it was ranked #1,156 in the world by US News & World Report.

spots.name: Victory Park
spots.summary: Victory Park on Sokolovaya Mountain is a memorial park in the Volzhsky Municipal District of Saratov, Russia. The park is dedicated to the Soviet victory in World War II.

spots.summary: Sobinov Theatre Institute of the Saratov State Conservatory (Russian: Саратовская государственная консерватория имени Л.В. Собинова is a music conservatory in Russia.
